_comment: Earnings screens as tesseract reads them, for earnings.js's parse (tests/earnings.test.js), in the shared corpus's shape: a name, the text, and what must come out. Every restaurant, street, town and figure is INVENTED; the layout is the owner's Uber Earnings Activity screenshot of 7 Nov 2026, which is not in the repository. 'now' is when the screenshot is read (epoch ms), for a heading with no year. No DoorDash earnings screenshot has been seen, so the DoorDash case is only that it reads nothing and says so.
